nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real normed space, let $s \subseteq E$ be open, and let $f \colon E \to \mathbb{R}$ be convex on $s$ with a Fréchet derivative $Df(z)$ at every $z \in s$. If $Df$ is differentiable at $y \in s$ with derivative $D^2 f(y)$, then $D^2 f(y)(v, v) \ge 0$ for every $v \in E$.
